title: Gakuen Alice
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Country girl Mikan Sakura follows her best friend Hotaru to Alice Academy, an elite Tokyo boarding school for children with unique powers called 'Alices'. Enrolled after discovering she has a rare Alice of her own, Mikan finds that behind its grand facade the academy hides lies, manipulation and dangerous secrets tied to her own heritage. Friendship, especially with Hotaru and the prickly fire-user Natsume, carries her through growing trials.
life_message: Loyal friendship and a cheerful, courageous heart can stand against powerful institutions that use children.

content.note: The academy grows 'dangerous' and Mikan must 'survive' (Wikipedia, publisher blurb); specifics not documented. Cap at 3 (to verify).
